item: Living sources: the OSM daily change files, with each re-baseline as a dated event (v0.6.0 B1, S06-01 S5)
key_paths: src/osm/daily_view.py; src/api/living.py; src/static/app-living.js; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_osm_daily_view.py; tests/living_sources_node_test.js
summary: The Living sources OSM view gains a Daily change files group: how many cut countries the daily files reached, how many files were applied, the newest file's own date, and every re-baseline (the mirror no longer held the files a country needed, so it was cut again) as a dated event with its country, newest first. A hand re-cut is counted apart. A table an older lane lacks reads Not recorded with the reason, never 0; an absent or unreadable lane is named. Read-only, no request. 15 new keys in 12 locales. The picker's cost line was already shipped (S05-04 S3, _osmDiffEstimate); nothing was added there.
